summary: Malheur NF summit lookout in Grant County, OR: standard house built 1922, L-4 cab 1941, removed or destroyed 1967; a hiking guide reports the foundation still on the summit.

facts.design: Standard lookout house with a cupola (1922); L-4 cab from 1941
facts.status_note: Lookout removed or destroyed in 1967; a hiking guide reports the summit still shows the foundation and some debris.

access.note: Hiking guide describes an out-and-back hike from McClellan Trailhead on the old lookout road, now a trail and ATV track.

visit.trail_note: Out-and-back hike from the McClellan Trailhead; the old lookout road is now a trail and ATV track; a snowdrift or two can block the top through June

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register dates the first cabin to 1933; firelookout.com lists a 1922 cupola cabin, and the 1922 reports quoted on the Oregon lookouts page describe the summit house being built. The story uses 1922.
Register says the cab was removed in 1967; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1967; the Oregon history says removed with no year. The year is agreed.

notes_for_editor: Not cited: dangerousroads.org says a tower was built in 1933 and taken down in 1967, leaving only the access track. It conflicts with the 1922 reports and the hiking guide's foundation account, so it was not used. Access level 'public' is inferred from the hiking guide's trailhead hike; no closure notice was read. The 'today' claim (foundation and detritus on the summit) rests on one hiking guide; its date is not stated beyond a 2023 trailhead note. Staffing as_of 1942 is the latest dated staff mention found. Used 1 WebSearch and 5 page reads. Brief record (gone, 2011 registration, USFS, 2,244 m) checks out; no corrections.
